title: Data Security: MySQL Security Practices
description:
Welcome to our channel! In this tutorial, we'll cover MySQL security practices that are essential for protecting your data. Data security is a critical aspect of database management, and we'll guide you through the steps you can take to improve your MySQL security level.

🧑 Author:
Muhammad Sya'bani Falif - 1305213048 - DS4501 (To fulfill the course of Data Security)

🚨 Why MySQL Security is Important:
Data is a valuable asset, and keeping MySQL secure is crucial to protecting sensitive information from cyber threats. In this tutorial, we will help you understand ways to improve your MySQL security, reducing the risk of potential security vulnerabilities.

Timecodes
00:00 - Introduction
00:35 - Changing the Default Port
01:28 - Deleting and Disabling the mysql_history file
02:33 - Creating Accounts and Privileges
08:07 - Lock Accounts on Suspicious Activity
09:35 - Using Authentication Plugins
11:10 - Check and Remove Privileges of Each Account
15:25 - Create a Role
